formal_statement: PEqualNP.Library.NPHard PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.PartialMCSP → ∃ L : Language Bool, (∃ k : ℕ, L ∈ PEqualNP.Library.DTIME (fun n : ℕ => 2 ^ (n ^ k) + k)) ∧ ¬ (L ∈ PEqualNP.Library.NP ∧ L ∈ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.PPoly)
plain_statement: CONJECTURE, our adaptation, not found stated in the literature: if partial MCSP (full table given) is NP-hard under deterministic polynomial-time many-one reductions, some language decided in time 2^(n^k) + k is not in NP intersect P/poly. Adapts Murray and Williams, Theory of Computing 13, 2017, Theorem 4.1: the zero completion of the table bounds the partial circuit size.
title: TARGET: NP-hardness of partial MCSP separates EXP from NP intersect P/poly
